summary: Mobile parity for Notifications feed + Deployed AI Employees directory verified end-to-end. All 6 backend tests pass. All mobile UI wiring works: NotificationBell present on all 4 tabs, badge renders unread count, tapping navigates to /notifications, 'Mark all read' clears badge, You-tab 'Deployed Employees' link and builder-dashboard rocket icon both navigate to /builder/deployed, admin sees empty state (no deployments in demo ws), member (raj) sees 'Admins only' (mb-dd-denied).
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.tsx unread state resets to 0 whenever the load fetch errors silently (catch(() => {})). Consider preserving last-known count on transient failures to avoid flicker.

notifications.tsx open() handler silently ignores POST /:id/read failures (apiPost(...).catch(() => {})). Optimistic-update pattern is fine, but on failure the local state is now inconsistent with the server. Consider revalidating on error.
builder/deployed.tsx catches error and sets denied=true if message contains '403' or 'admin' — brittle string match. Prefer inspecting the HTTPException status field on the api client if available.
